title: Governance posts from unregistered forum accounts may be disregarded entirely
content:
A.2.7.1.1.1.1.1 requires that "All forum accounts used to post on the Sky Forum in a governance capacity must be registered" in the Current Authorized Forum Accounts list, recording an entity handle plus "All Authorized Representatives, which are forum accounts held by team members, individuals, or other entities that are authorized to post on behalf of the entity." A.2.7.1.1.1.1.2 adds a disclosure duty when posting for someone else, and A.2.7.1.1.1.1.3 supplies the sanction: "Posts on governance matters from unregistered forum accounts may be disregarded for governance purposes," with repeat offenders subject to moderation.

The enforcement mechanism is what makes this workable. Nothing prevents an unregistered account from posting — the consequence is that the post carries no governance weight. Attribution, not access, is what is being gated, which keeps an open forum open while making official positions traceable to an accountable entity.

The registry is deliberately identity-light. It links handles to entities, not to legal persons, and A.2.7.1.1.1.1.4 makes it Active Data whose "Responsible Party is the entity to which the registration pertains" updated by "Direct Edit" — entities maintain their own entries with no gatekeeper. That fits an ecosystem where Aligned Delegates may be anonymous: the requirement is knowing *who speaks for whom*, not who anyone is.

Two details show the design accommodating reality. An entity with no handle of its own "may indicate this in the registry and rely solely on Authorized Representatives," and "A single forum handle may appear as an Authorized Representative of more than one (1) entity" — visible in the published list, where SoterLabs represents several distinct roles. Overlapping representation is permitted and disclosed rather than prohibited, which is honest about a small ecosystem where the same operators wear several hats.
description: Any account posting in a governance capacity must appear in the Authorized Forum Accounts registry, and representatives must disclose whose behalf they post on; repeat offenders face moderation.
